text: I feel terrible and I'll never go there again; I'll remember this forever. We were talking to the doctor in the examination room when my 4-year-old told me he wanted to go play with his toys while he waited. Turns out, he opened the door and went outside the clinic, where there was a lot of traffic around 6 pm. I asked the staff, but no one knew or saw anything. They completely ignored the child. If he had been hit by a car, who would be responsible? I thought the staff would take care of him because I had asked them to keep an eye on him. In the end, I admit I was wrong for letting my child out of my sight, but I didn't expect the clinic staff to be so indifferent to a child walking out alone. The counter staff were incredibly rude. I called out for my child loudly, but no staff member came out to ask anything. I ran around looking for my child myself. There was absolutely no safety for my child.

text:
I'm writing this review because I'm a dentist myself and I had a toothache 🤣 It was a difficult case that was hard to find someone to do because it required root canal treatment and removal of the old crown and post. After searching for a clinic and a highly skilled specialist, I found this place ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ Most importantly, the doctor was able to really solve the problem! Confirmed by fellow dentists!!!

The doctor is incredibly kind and gives excellent advice. Every step was done according to research, using the best materials and being very meticulous. They have state-of-the-art equipment and root canal endoscopes, just like leading private hospitals. The price is very reasonable, and the quality is excellent.

The clinic is very clean. The assistants and nursing team are attentive, polite, and encouraging throughout the treatment. I was very impressed. I highly recommend it ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ No matter how far I travel, I would come here. Pure quality here!

P.S. The owner is beautiful and kind 😚💋

text: On July 18, 2024, I went to a clinic near my house because of gum and tooth pain. The doctor said there was no decay and didn't know where to fill it. I asked for a scaling procedure. It cost 1,200 baht (900 baht from social security + 300 baht cash, including X-rays). It wasn't resolved; the pain remained the same since leaving the clinic. Today, July 20, 2024, I went again because the symptoms were the same and hadn't improved at all. I asked to see a new doctor in case they could see something. The doctor said they could see something and filled the tooth, charging me again 1,400 baht + 50 baht for the second service fee. It was just one filling. 📌The reason I went: I told the doctor I wanted either a filling or an extraction because the pain was severe. What would the clinic owner do if I didn't have the money to pay? Please let me know. Is tooth and gum pain also related to tartar buildup?

text: I'm very impressed! The dentist is so kind. Everything was explained before the treatment. They showed me the dental x-rays on a screen and explained the details of the treatment process, including the price, so I understood everything perfectly. Today I went in for root canal treatment. I was very scared, but the dentist reassured me that it would turn out well, and it wasn't painful at all! I'm incredibly impressed. This will be my regular clinic now. The assistants are also lovely and very polite; everyone is always smiling. I highly recommend this clinic. I'm usually terrified of dental procedures, but this time I felt so much more at ease. 😊

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมศรีราชาสไมล์
text:
I came here because of tooth pain and sensitivity. My first visit was on June 8, 2023. The dentist examined my teeth thoroughly, took X-rays, and checked the vitality of my teeth.
In conclusion, root canal treatment was necessary, so I scheduled an appointment with a specialist.
I had root canal treatment on two front teeth, two visits in total. The last treatment was on June 25, 2023.
Each time, the anesthetic injection was the most painful part of the root canal treatment. After the procedure and the anesthetic wore off, there was some soreness for the first few days, but it quickly subsided.
The dentist explained everything well and was happy to answer any questions.
I saw two dentists, both of whom were kind.

It's best to call the clinic to schedule an appointment before coming for faster service.
There isn't much parking in front of the clinic, but there seems to be additional parking behind the clinic.
